156946294a15.label: install VM stack
156946294a15.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('ytl-kit-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://192.168.50.111:8471/kit/Install-VmStack.ps1' -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp 'Install-VmStack.ps1')
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://192.168.50.111:8471/kit/QemuShim.cs' -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp 'QemuShim.cs')
$log = Join-Path $tmp 'install.log'
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $tmp 'Install-VmStack.ps1') *>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $log
$code = $LASTEXITCODE
if (Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'REBOOT NOW|reboot is required' -Quiet) {
    Write-Output '[REBOOT-REQUIRED] reboot the laptop, then re-run the connect line'
    exit 42
}
exit $code

08ea58d31fea.label: create 1 VM(s)
08ea58d31fea.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ('ytl-kit-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 8))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tmp | Out-Null
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://192.168.50.111:8471/kit/New-LaptopVm.ps1' -OutFile (Join-Path $tmp 'New-LaptopVm.ps1')
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $tmp 'New-LaptopVm.ps1') -MasterUrl 'http://192.168.50.111:8471' -Count 1 -Name 'laptop-vm'
exit $LASTEXITCODE

ff2dc6123a30.label: start beacon (auto)
ff2dc6123a30.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$dir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ytl-beacon'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
$script = Join-Path $dir 'Register-Nodes.ps1'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://192.168.50.111:8471/kit/Register-Nodes.ps1' -OutFile $script
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='powershell.exe'" |
    Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*Register-Nodes.ps1*' } |
    ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-WindowStyle','Hidden','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$script,'-MasterUrl','http://192.168.50.111:8471','-Token','nils' -WindowStyle Hidden
Write-Output 'beacon started (hidden window, re-registers VMs every 30 s)'
